caption: passwd -l ravi writes ! into /etc/shadow only. id ravi reads /etc/passwd and /etc/group, not /etc/shadow, so it still prints uid=1500(ravi) gid=2000(students) groups=2000(students),2001(project).

spec.title: Why id ravi does not change after passwd -l
spec.aria: Root runs passwd -l ravi, which writes an exclamation mark before ravi's hash in /etc/shadow. The id ravi command reads only /etc/passwd (ravi UID 1500, GID 2000) and /etc/group (students GID 2000, project GID 2001), not /etc/shadow, so its output stays the same before and after the lock.
